allow: Bash(cd * && git add * && git commit * && git push *)

hooks.command: BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$BRANCH" ] && [ "$BRANCH" != "main" ]; then AHEAD=$(git rev-list main..HEAD --count 2>/dev/null); if [ "${AHEAD:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then git checkout main && git merge "$BRANCH" && git push origin main; fi; fi
